name: display-redaction
description: A mod that masks email addresses and secret-shaped text in what Claude Code draws, for recordings and screen shares. It changes the screen only; the transcript, the model's context and the files on disk are untouched, so it is not a privacy or data control.

mask_style.title: Mask style
mask_style.description: How a match in a reply, prompt or command output is hidden. block draws it as a solid bar that shows the value while the pointer is over it; text replaces it with [hidden]. Tool rows always use [hidden].

extra_patterns.title: Extra mask patterns
extra_patterns.description: Regular expressions to mask in addition to the built-in email and secret shapes, one per list entry. A pattern that is invalid, over 200 characters, can match empty text, or could backtrack too long (nested or stacked quantifiers, alternation inside a repeated group, a backreference) is skipped.
